items.computation: Invoice date is 13.05.2025. The period runs 'ab Rechnungsdatum' (from the invoice date), so under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the invoice date itself is not counted; counting starts on 14.05.2025. 21 days later: 14.05.2025 + 21 days = 03.06.2025 would be day 20, so day 21 falls on 04.06.2025 (17 remaining days of May from the 15th to the 31st, plus 4 days into June). 04.06.2025 is a Wednesday, not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW, so no extension under § 193 BGB is needed.
